verdicts.reason: A: the 'SYMPTOMS' headline runs almost into the symptom list, so the two text columns crowd each other. The list runs nearly the full canvas height, the doctor is shrunk to a small cut-off bust that floats above the CTA, and the CTA text is tiny. B has the same crowding between headline and list and a doctor illustration cut off by a flat edge. It also blows the sparkle up into a large orphaned element at the bottom of the list, and its CTA and hashtag text are even smaller and harder to read. That makes B's arrangement less deliberate than A's.
